text: Spirituality at work is a recent issue that has been growing over the last two decades. Its thematic axis develops mainly on the discipline of organizational behavior in the context of culture. Given the interdisciplinary content of behavior, contributions from different areas of knowledge are expected. Work psychology is one of the areas with the greatest potential to contribute to this topic of spirituality at work, as it combines knowledge about the perception of individuality and its relationships with the organizational environment.
source_label: An Initial Approach to Increase Job Satisfaction Through Workplace Spirituality
